messages:
sarah_infra: Heads up — after the NCCL 2.19.1 roll last night we are seeing intermittent collective timeouts and hung allreduce calls on multi-GPU inference in eu-central-1 (p4d-like instances).

jia_runtime: Confirmed. Canary logs show repeated NCCL timeout messages and processes stuck in ncclCommInitRank.

miguel_ml: Noticed tail latency spikes on our streaming transformer jobs too. 95th/99th latency doubled for batches >32.

kevin_sre: Symptoms? Are GPUs still responsive locally (compute ok) or is it inter-node only? Any NIC errors?

sarah_infra: Single-node multi-GPU runs sometimes hang too. On a few nodes we saw netdev RX errors on mlx5, but not consistently. io/driver stack looks noisy.

jia_runtime: Grabbed NCCL debug output:
```
NCCL INFO Channel 0: connect GDR:0 -> ret -9
NCCL WARN Allreduce timed out after 120000ms
backtrace: 0x7f1c2f.. <ncclAllReduce> ...
```

anya_eng: Deploy-bot shows the canary started at 02:14 UTC and finished at 02:48; but autoscale bumped more nodes in eu-central while canary was running.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed: image redwood/runtime:v2026-04-18. Note: NCCL upgraded to 2.19.1 in this image.

kevin_sre: Quick hypothesis: NCCL 2.19 defaulted to a new transport/kernel path that exposes a kernel or OFED mismatch on some hosts. Driver/CUDA/OFED combos matter. What driver/CUDA are those hosts on?

sarah_infra: Most eu-central hosts are driver 535.86 + CUDA 12.2 stack; some older hosts still on 525.x. Kernel versions vary: 6.1.84 and 5.15 variants.

miguel_ml: We saw similar when we bumped drivers last year — mixed driver fleet + RDMA can cause hangs. Suggest trying NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 on a test job to see if it falls back to sockets.

jia_runtime: Reproduced locally with NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 vs mlx5. With IB enabled we see the timeout, with IB disabled the job completes (slower but stable).

anya_eng: Risk assessment: disabling IB globally will increase token cost; but keeps infra stable. Rollback options: (A) rollback NCCL to 2.18 across eu-central canary group; (B) disable IB on suspect hosts; (C) pin NIC driver / kernel versions.

kevin_sre: Short term: patch canary group to export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 for runtime. Schedule rollback to 2.18 if that doesn't mitigate. I'll open a maintenance window with infra.

sarah_infra: Will push a canary with env change in 10m and monitor. Also capturing coredumps/syscalls for hung processes: enabling NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and gcore.

jia_runtime: Added these troubleshooting commands to the thread:
```
# check topology
nvidia-smi topo -m
# NCCL debug
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1     # test
# reproduce
python -u run_infer.py --batch 64 --profile
```

miguel_ml: Also note collective perf drop for allreduce when using 2.19 on smaller batch sizes — not just hangs. We should add perf histograms to telemetry.

kevin_sre: Action items:
- kevin_sre: rollout NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 to eu-central canary group (in progress)
- sarah_infra: collect and upload kernel dmesg + mlx logs for affected nodes
- jia_runtime: add NCCL_DEBUG traces and open an upstream issue with vendor and NCCL team
- anya_eng: notify EU customers if we need a wider rollback (standby)

anya_eng: I'll draft a brief customer note but hold until we confirm mitigation.

deploy-bot: Canary env patch applied to 8 instances in eu-central-1 at 03:22 UTC.

sarah_infra: Early signal: patched canary looks stable for ~8m. No new hangs so far, latency still slightly elevated.

jia_runtime: Can someone collect libibverbs and ofed versions from a problematic host? Command: `ibv_devinfo && modinfo mlx5_core`

kevin_sre: Collected: mlx5_core 5.19.19, libibverbs 64.0.0, kernel 6.1.84-12. Some older hosts had mlx5_core 5.11 and kernel 5.15.

miguel_ml: That variance aligns with the repro surface. We'll schedule a controlled NCCL 2.19 re-test on a homogeneous subset (single driver/kernel).

sarah_infra: For now, keeping IB disabled in eu-central canary. If stable for 24h we'll consider a staged reintroduce with stricter host selection.

kevin_sre: I'll also add a fleet check to prevent mixed-driver hosts entering the same GPU pool during upgrades.

anya_eng: Filing incident ticket and tracking board. Thanks all — good triage. :thumbsup:

jia_runtime: Created GH issue: redwood/runtime#4721 with logs and repro steps. Linking NV bug ID when we have it.

sarah_infra: Marking this thread for follow-ups — will update when rollback or reintroduce plan changes.
